description: Read a fluid mesh or fluid property from files.

keywords.name: nodes
keywords.description: Read the node file s. Nodes and elements cannot previously exist.

keywords.name: elements
keywords.description: Read the element file s. Nodes must exist, but elements cannot previously exist.

keywords.name: velocity
keywords.description: Read the fluid velocity from the file s.

keywords.name: pressure
keywords.description: Read the fluid pressure from the file s.

keywords.name: gradp
keywords.description: Read the fluid pressure gradient from the file s.

keywords.name: viscosity
keywords.description: Read the fluid viscosity from the file s.

keywords.name: density
keywords.description: Read the fluid density from the file s.

examples.description: Read the fluid mesh elements (nodes must exist)

notes: Node file format: first line gives the node count (twice); each following line is 'index x y z' with indices starting at 1.

Element file format: first line gives the element count (twice); each element takes three lines - the type code (8 hexahedral, 6 tetrahedral), then 'index' plus 8 (or 4) node indices plus four unused floats, then one unused integer line.
Property file format (velocity/pressure/gradp/viscosity/density): first line is the element count, then one line per element with one number (scalars) or three (vectors).
Python alternative for mesh import: itasca.cfdarray.create_mesh(nodes, elements).
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): a 12-node/2-hexahedra mesh read on all three consoles (element.cfd.num = 2) and every property file read back exactly via element.cfd.* FISH intrinsics (pressure 101/102, gradp z -9810, viscosity 0.001, density 998).
